t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes vary in terms of color, the green, blue and yellow gnome will lead me to the light forest while the others will lead me to the dark forest. Every other difference is irrelevant. I am to observer the forests and see which gives the most mushrooms and focus on those.

vb_textbox.text: Hello, this does not have to be lengthy. The color of the gnomes matter, if you are getting high number of mushrooms from the light colored gnomes then stick to that and whenever it starts producing low number of mushrooms then you switch to the darker colored gnomes.
